result:
Everything checks out. Both `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass cleanly.

## Summary

Added a draft/published switch for posts:

- **`db/schema.ts`**: new `posts.published` boolean column, `NOT NULL DEFAULT false`.
- **`db/migrations/20260818095834_dizzy_inhumans/`**: migration adds the column, then backfills existing rows to `published = 1` (preserving today's "everything is public" behavior for pre-existing data) while new inserts default to draft.
- **`app/Models/Post.ts`**: `published` added to `fillable`.
- **`app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`**: `PostPayloadSchema` gains `published: z.boolean().optional().default(false)` — omitted on create ⇒ draft.
- **`app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts`**: `published: boolean` added to the serialized post shape used by every page.
- **`app/Policies/PostPolicy.ts`**: `view` now returns true only for published posts or the post's own author.
- **`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`**: `index`/`search` filter to `published = true`; `show` checks `can('view', ...)` and throws `ModelNotFoundException` (404, not 403) for a draft viewed by anyone but its author, so a draft's existence is never hinted at. `store`/`update` already pass the validated `published` field through unchanged.
- **`app/Http/Controllers/HomeController.ts`**: latest-posts query also filters to published only, keeping the "only published posts are public" rule consistent site-wide.
- **`db/seeders/002_posts.ts`**: demo posts now seed with `published: true`.
- **`resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx` / `Edit.tsx`**: added a "Published" checkbox bound to `form.data.published`; New's submit button renamed "Save post" since unchecked now means draft.
- **`.guren/*.gen.ts`**: regenerated via `bun run codegen` to type `published` through the API client/data types.
- **`tests/PostController.drafts.test.ts`**: new end-to-end test suite (real HTTP requests, real test SQLite DB) covering default-to-draft on create, guest/non-author 404 on a draft's page, exclusion from the list and search, author access to their own draft (page + edit), and publish/unpublish via the edit form.

I also manually verified the migration against the dev database with a pre-existing (pre-migration) post: it applied cleanly and the old row came out `published: 1`, and a fresh `db:seed` run produces published demo posts — confirming the "existing data" requirement end to end.
